title: Performance Orbit — Q3 Manager Prep & Micro-goals
body:
Purpose / quick note:
- Short prep doc for my 1:1 with manager (Mar 3).
- Capture wins, evidence, ambiguity, asks, and a 90-day plan I can iterate on.

Topline summary (30s):
- Focus: build a repeatable onboarding pathway for new ICs in people-ops; reduce time-to-impact from ~8w to ~5w for core tasks.
- Recent wins: shipped new onboarding checklist + role-specific playbooks (pilot w/ 3 hires), led two calibration syncs that aligned hiring rubric across Eng & Product.

Concrete metrics / evidence:
- Onboarding checklist adoption: 3 hires used end-to-end in pilot; average first independent hire task completion improved from 8.1w -> 5.3w (sample n=3, still noisy).
- Hiring rubric alignment: reduced rubric variance score (inter-rater disagreement proxy) from 0.43 -> 0.28 across 12 interviews (internal metric).
- Time spent on ad-hoc support: down ~15% month-over-month after templating common playbooks (tracked in weekly support spreadsheet).
- Feedback snippets: "onboarding guide saved me multiple hours" (E2), "much clearer expectations around week 1" (new hire survey).

Impact stories (short):
- Feb 11: New hire A completed onboarding checklist and delivered first recruiting plan by week 4 — manager flagged increased confidence.
- Feb 18: Ran rubric sync with Eng managers; one manager updated interview scoring guidance in Jira to match new rubric (jira:HR-889).

Open questions / uncertainty:
- Sample sizes are small; need broader rollout to validate 5w claim.
- We don't yet know long-term retention impact of the onboarding changes.
- Org bandwidth risk: if hiring ramps, will need a coordinator (0.2–0.3 FTE) to keep pilot consistency.

Asks for manager (specific):
1) Calibration & visibility: review the onboarding comp plan and approve a cross-team rollout to 10 hires this quarter so we can get statistical confidence. (Decision required by Mar 15)
2) Headcount or hours: short-term request for 0.2 FTE coordinator for three months (or reallocate contract recruiter hours).
3) Career conversation: want feedback on promotion readiness for IC3 -> IC4 (context below). Looking for concrete examples where I should be more outward facing.
4) Mentorship: can you intro me to a PM leader who ran onboarding scale at previous company? One intro would help accelerate the playbook design.

Promotion readiness evidence (what I think):
- Strengths: shipped cross-functional artifacts, measurable improvements (time-to-impact proxy), strong stakeholder management (eng, product, recruiting).
- Gaps: less visible on company-wide strategy documents; could present more at all-hands or GTM syncs.
- Ask: what two examples should I bring to calibration to make the case?

90-day plan (draft):
- Weeks 1–2: finalize rollout plan + materials, prepare short training session for hiring managers; open calendar for onboarding pilots.
- Weeks 3–8: run 10-hire pilot, collect standardized metrics (time-to-first-task, NPS, manager confidence), weekly sync with coordinator.
- Weeks 9–12: analyze results, write short TL;DR + proposed next steps (scale or pivot).

Success criteria (for me):
- Quantitative: demonstrate median time-to-first-core-task <= 5.5 weeks across pilot (n>=8).
- Qualitative: manager satisfaction >= 4/5 on pilot survey; hiring managers adopt at least 2 checklist items as a hard step in their interviews.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: pilot not large enough -> Mitigation: run second wave in month 4 and predefine acceptance thresholds.
- Risk: coordinator not funded -> Mitigation: shift scope, focus on top 3 hires and use templates + async training.

Prep for 1:1 (agenda):
- 3 min headline (topline summary)
- 8 min evidence + ask for cross-team rollout approval
- 7 min headcount/hours ask + scope of coordinator role
- 7 min career/promotion discussion + feedback request
- 5 min quick blockers and next steps

Notes to self (post-1:1 followups):
- Capture manager’s suggested concrete examples for promotion packet; add to this doc.
- Draft rollout comms and rough calendar; share with Marco for feedback.
- Update confluence page with pilot plan + measurement template (confluence:PP-342).

Random todo bullets / brain dump:
- Consider a 15-min playbook walkthrough for new managers (recorded).
- Create one-pager cheat sheet of "first 30-day tasks" for hiring managers and new hires.
- Check with legal about access provisioning timeline (security dependencies).
- Follow up with recruiting on capacity for pilot hires (Lina).

Tone / reminders: keep it concise, show clear data points, be explicit about decision needed and timeline.

End of scratchpad.
